How Fast Is 'Instant' — Really?

Once you accept the valuation, payment is made in the same visit: cash at the counter, a cheque, or a bank transfer initiated in front of you. Testing, valuation and payment together usually take a single short visit.

Bank transfer is available for any amount and is a sensible choice for larger transactions, so you carry no cash at all. You receive the transfer confirmation and a proper receipt before you leave.

If you accept a valuation but prefer to be paid later, note that gold rates change daily — a later sale is valued at that day's rate. Most customers complete everything in one visit.

How It Works

How to Sell Your Gold in 3 Easy Steps

1

Visit Our Branch

Bring your gold, silver or diamond items and one valid photo ID to our South Extension branch — 1515, Upper Ground Floor, Wazir Nagar, South Extension Part I, Kotla Mubarakpur, New Delhi 110003. No appointment needed.

2

Get Your Gold Evaluated

We test purity on the German Karat Meter in front of you, weigh the item at the counter, and give you a fair, transparent price at the day's market rate — the full calculation explained.

3

Receive Instant Payment

Accept our offer and get paid in the same visit via cash, cheque or bank transfer, with a proper receipt. If you don't accept, you take your items back — free, no obligation.
